subject: Fix uninitialized variable use in clusterManagerMigrateKeysInSlot (#5311)
reason: The change fixes an uninitialized-variable read in valkey-cli's clusterManagerMigrateKeysInSlot (src/valkey-cli.c): in the parent build, 'dots', 'reply' and 'migrate_reply' were declared after the cliSelect() call, and the 'if (cliSelect(...) == VALKEY_ERR) goto next;' branch jumps over their initializers to the 'next:' label, which then calls freeReplyObject/zfree on uninitialized stack pointers. The bug only triggers when cliSelect() fails (an I/O error on the source connection) inside valkey-cli's per-database slot-migration loop during '--cluster reshard/move/fix', which move slots between
